qualification.native_source_regression: Shuffled ranked projections read typed values, exact integer >2^53 and nested paths without decoding the unrequested 256 KiB payload. Delete masks and both append/sorted compaction preserve row mapping. Whole-source reconstruction retains payload; raw stored length is five bytes. Exhaustive allocation-failure sweeps pass without leaks.
qualification.real_file_regressions: Selective Boolean queries preserve exact answers and the zero-ordered-reference cost choice before/after restart. Broad text with residual filters independently qualifies primary-boundary stopping. Multi-pack projection and hidden highlights work with the real Parquet object unavailable, zero physical hydration and restart. Iceberg snapshots, schema IDs, partitions, deletes and accepted writes pass.

limitations: Nested paths read the containing top-level typed JSON column; no nested leaf-level storage claim.
The wide-key control still reads authenticated ordered-key navigation and its final boundary; source columns do not remove that work.
Physical-projection controls intentionally change store_source and therefore pack size/layout; they are not isolated causal latency experiments.
